units.why: Frames AI as 'a professional tool' students will meet at work, so teaching its use is a career skill (P44).

units.passage: Learning to use AI is an emerging skill, and I will provide basic tutorials about how to leverage it for our work.
units.why: 'Learning to use AI is an emerging skill, and I will provide basic tutorials' frames AI use as a skill the course teaches (P44).

units.passage: For students, AI literacy is essential for future success because employers are expecting graduates to understand and use AI tools responsibly.
units.why: States the career reason for AI literacy: 'employers are expecting graduates to understand and use AI tools responsibly'. Coded P44 (AI as professional skill) and not P87 because the claim is about employers.

units.passage: Faculty are being asked to prepare students for a workforce where AI literacy will be essential, not optional, so instructors need to understand not only how to use AI effectively for their own work, but how to effectively weave it into their teaching.
units.why: Says faculty 'are being asked to prepare students for a workforce where AI literacy will be essential, not optional', an expectation on instructors tied to careers, so P44.

units.passage: Follow this up by demonstrating key benefits and limitations of AI and show how AI writing differs from natural writing.
units.why: "demonstrating key benefits and limitations of AI and show how AI writing differs from natural writing" asks instructors to teach about AI in class, P44 (courses demonstrate AI use).
